# Microsoft Foundry Model Releases

> Release capsules for Microsoft Foundry model announcements — each pairs a model release with a runnable notebook. A capsule is a folder holding a README and a Jupyter notebook you can run against your own Foundry project.

Announcements are tracked in ANNOUNCEMENTS.md, newest first, grouped by month. Capsules are indexed in CAPSULES.md, grouped by provider. catalog.json holds this same index in structured form.

## Capsules

- [Microsoft-Decision-1](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/tree/main/models/microsoft/microsoft-decision-1): Route, rank, and gate decisions with calibrated probabilities instead of generated text. Publisher: microsoft. Capabilities: decision-models. Released 2026-10-09.
- [MAI-Transcribe-2](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/tree/main/models/microsoft-ai/mai-transcribe-2): Transcribe noisy multilingual audio with diarization, timestamps, and domain biasing. Publisher: microsoft-ai. Capabilities: audio-speech. Released 2026-09-03.
- [Model Router — August 2026](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/tree/main/models/model-router/aug-2026): Catch up on routing modes, model subsets, deployment types, failover, and agentic routing as optimization levers. Publisher: model-router. Capabilities: model-router, chat-completion, function-calling. Released 2026-08-19.
- [MAI-Image-2.5-Pro](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/tree/main/models/microsoft-ai/mai-image-2.5-pro): Render portraits, in-image text, and complex scenes. Publisher: microsoft-ai. Capabilities: image-generation. Released 2026-07-23.
- [MAI-Voice-2](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/tree/main/models/microsoft-ai/mai-voice-2): Direct expressive, multilingual, and long-form speech synthesis. Publisher: microsoft-ai. Capabilities: audio-speech. Released 2026-06-02.
- [MAI-Transcribe-1.5](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/tree/main/models/microsoft-ai/mai-transcribe-1.5): Transcribe multilingual audio with keyword biasing. Publisher: microsoft-ai. Capabilities: audio-speech. Released 2026-06-02.
- [MAI-Image-2.5-Flash](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/tree/main/models/microsoft-ai/mai-image-2.5-flash): Generate images faster and at lower cost. Publisher: microsoft-ai. Capabilities: image-generation. Released 2026-06-02.
- [MAI-Image-2.5](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/tree/main/models/microsoft-ai/mai-image-2.5): Generate and edit images from text prompts. Publisher: microsoft-ai. Capabilities: image-generation. Released 2026-06-02.

## Multi-model scenarios

- [MAI-Image-2.5 family walkthrough](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/tree/main/models/microsoft-ai/multi-model-scenarios/mai-image-family-walkthrough): Compare MAI-Image-2.5, Flash, and Pro on identical prompts. Compares: mai-image-2.5-flash, mai-image-2.5, mai-image-2.5-pro.

## Primers

- [audio-speech](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/audio-speech.md): STT, TTS, or realtime voice.
- [chat-completion](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/chat-completion.md): General instruction-following and dialogue.
- [decision-models](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/decision-models.md): Ask typed questions about some state and get back choices, scores, or probabilities our code can branch on.
- [embeddings](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/embeddings.md): Vector representations for retrieval / similarity.
- [fine-tuning](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/fine-tuning.md): Supports customization / distillation.
- [function-calling](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/function-calling.md): Structured tool invocation.
- [image-generation](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/image-generation.md): Text → image output.
- [long-context](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/long-context.md): 200k+ token context window.
- [Model Architecture](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/model-architecture.md): How a model is built, from dense and Mixture of Experts layers to attention and hybrids, and what that means for speed, memory, and cost.
- [Model Cards](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/model-cards.md): How to read a model card, from parameters and context window to deployment, pricing, and limits.
- [model-router](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/model-router.md): One endpoint that routes requests across models.
- [multimodal](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/multimodal-models.md): Accepts image (and/or audio) input alongside text.
- [reasoning](https://github.com/microsoft-foundry/model-releases/blob/main/docs/primers/reasoning-models.md): Extended-thinking / chain-of-thought optimized models.
